biotools.summary: MotifPeeker is an R package designed to benchmark epigenomic profiling methods by analyzing motif enrichment. It generates an HTML report summarizing general metrics, known motif enrichment, and de-novo motif discovery, and is available on Bioconductor with a Docker image for ease of use.
